collection.intro: Frames pulled from the quiet places — portrait, broadcast, verse, culture, and the stages in between. Tap any card to open it fuller.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.intro: Snapshots collected between two homes. Click any frame to see it fuller.

shop.intro: Books, prints, zines. Small runs. Purchase links open in a new tab.

footprints.title: Footprints
footprints.intro: Past work — news appearances, creator videos, and other projects, gathered in one place.

diaries.intro: Entries kept between Lusaka and Tokyo. Half journalism, half apology.

stories.title: Stories
stories.intro: Essays and reported pieces. Slower than a diary, sharper than a poem.

newsletterPage.title: Letters from the Lounge
newsletterPage.intro: Occasional dispatches when there's something worth sending — new poems, diary entries, Dear Today notes, and shop drops. No noise, no schedule to keep.

show.title: The Show
show.intro: Live broadcasts, conversations and readings — plus every past episode.

settings.title: Settings
settings.appearanceDesc: Your colour theme applies everywhere — reading pages, your account and the studio. It is remembered on this device.
settings.signInPrompt: to bookmark favourites, comment and manage your profile.
settings.motionDesc: The Last Mukwasu follows your system “reduce motion” setting automatically — hover reveals and zooms are minimised when it is switched on in your device accessibility settings.
